requirements.title: Admission prerequisites and grade average
requirements.summary: Consult the program administrator. Before admission complete 21-112 or 21-120, 15-122, 15-150, one of 15-210/15-213/15-251, and 07-280; earn a B average in prerequisite coursework.

requirements.title: Introductory AI recommendation
requirements.summary: 07-180 is encouraged before 07-280 but is not required for the additional major.

requirements.title: Aggregate overlap limit and exceptions
requirements.summary: At most five courses from CS Core, AI Core and AI Cluster Electives may double count across all other majors/minors combined. Mathematics, ethics and human cognition may double count without restriction; 36-402 remains subject to the five-course cap because it is a Machine Learning Cluster elective. Consult the administrator for substantially overlapping majors.
